notes: Per-app UI memory (atlas). Coordinates are normalized 0-1000 against the full screen. Each state carries a 16x9 average-hash fingerprint of a real screenshot; a click on a named target resolves to atlas coordinates ONLY when the fresh screenshot's fingerprint is within hamming distance 28 of the state's fingerprint. map.proceed and combat elements are verify=false because their screens vary per run. Teach pass for this file: operator (teacher) drove the fixed flow once on 2026-10-27 and grounded every verified element from real screenshots; the teach run was abandoned so graded runs start clean.

mode.standard.note: STANDARD mode card (left). Daily is center, Custom is right.

character.confirm.note: Blue checkmark confirm button, right edge

neow.option1.note: First Neow blessing row (contents vary per run; rows are fixed)

neow.proceed.note: Proceed button after a blessing is picked; its screen hashes within 14 of neow_event so this state gate covers it

map.proceed.note: PROCEED button bottom-left of the map screen. Map layout varies per run so no fingerprint gate; node positions are per-run and must be grounded by the model each run.

map.node.first_enemy.note: First-row ENEMY node (left) on this run's Act 1 map (seed HCP3XV8GWJ), taught mid-run from the run's own map screenshot 2026-10-27 after the model stalled grounding it. A second first-row node sits at about (576,509), partly behind the act title; the model may ground that one itself.

combat.end_turn.note: END TURN button, bottom-right of the combat screen. Grounded mid-run from the run's live combat screenshot (Overgrowth, first combat) 2026-10-27.
